answer: Randomized Slot Quota: each epoch, a public randomness beacon assigns every identity a slot in a fixed roster, and only the slot holder may submit one work claim; assignments stay sealed until the epoch opens, so attackers can't precompute which identities will win. Colluding identities frequently land at the roster's nadir, gaining nothing while paying registration, monitoring, and idle-slot costs per fake identity. A cryptographic quill signs each claim, binding it to the assigned slot and blocking reuse.
